readiness_assessment.role: offline development stage selection only, never an added runtime decision filter
readiness_assessment.required: sampling integrity tests; strict actor/evaluator separation; complete declared fixed states and branches; report both layouts and all states including failures
metrics: weighted source support of positive hypothetical reward at5cm
actual new source surface reconstructed at5cm, gross/lost/net separate
candidate rank association and prediction residuals
selected candidate actual increment and action cost
wall time and integral sample counts
readiness_assessment.rule: Do not promote a stage just because G/S diverges. Geometry/free-evidence must improve prediction consistency and avoid worsening aggregate candidate value ranking/selected actual increment. Mixed effects remain development findings, and only a justified stage receives a sealed full rollout protocol; no blind retuning to force a positive result.
readiness_assessment.independence: These old states and reference data are development evidence; not independent held-out validation.
readiness_assessment.aggregation: Per-state ranks and absolute quantities first, then equal-weight summary over six paired development states; 66 candidates are dependent, not 66 independent trials.
readiness_assessment.shrinkage_check: Check absolute supported and realized hypothesis weight alongside supported fraction and unique actual source area. Source-to-predicted-point nearest-neighbor recall at5cm is not used because template quadrature spacing can exceed5cm.
